name: basic
description: Parity test: same harness/cwd/input on CC and OC. Verifies (1) session-start injection of the 4 deterministic katana segments (guide/work-folder/retrieval/memory) reaches the LLM (forensic via each side's local session store: CC transcript jsonl / OC sqlite), and (2) the shared tool side effect (test.md write) lands on both sides. Inputs are byte-identical across sides; the prompt is intentionally light + deterministic.
prompt: Do exactly these steps, nothing more. 1) Use the write tool to create a file named test.md whose entire content is the single line: hello. 2) Reply with exactly one word: DONE
